text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malawi's anti-corruption bureau which officially opened its doors this year says it has no capacity to begin its operations amidst increased allegations of rampant corruption in government.

- Malawi's Information and Broadcasting Minister Brown Mpinganijira says government will not hurriedly liberalise broadcasting although it has unveiled a vigorous and ambitious trade liberalisation and privatisation policy.
